new_value: Part 1 (COSE_Key CCS {1:1,-1:6,-2:pk}) was already fixed at HEAD by concurrent commit d8469ca5ff. Part 2 (C_I msg1 transport encoding) implemented: RFC 9528 3.3.2 requires byte strings coinciding with one-byte CBOR integers (0x00-0x17, 0x20-0x37) to be transported AS the integer; both implementations violated this (Python cbor2 bstr 0x4100, Rust encode_bstr). Fixed existing helpers in place (Python _encode_connection_id, Rust external-crate cbor.rs encode_identifier), wired into C_I encode sites both sides (C_R sites already used them); fixtures regenerated from Python oracle: test/vectors/edhoc.json + oscore_context_parity.json (also fixes 2 pre-existing stale-fixture failures), external crate tests/vectors/edhoc.json synced. Tests: pytest python/tests/crypto -k edhoc 79/79 (was 77/2 fail), external cargo test --locked 72/72 + edhoc-schnorr48 profile 109/109, cargo test -p lichen-oscore --features edhoc 30/30 (RFC 9529 inline test untouched+green), test_vectors.py 751/751. Follow-ups filed: decode-side int-to-byte mapping asymmetry; PLAINTEXT kid bare-bstr form.
